# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Sample Instructions for AI Assistant

### Code Generation Guidelines
- Always use clear, descriptive variable names
- Include comments for complex logic
- Follow language-specific best practices
- Prefer readable code over clever code

### Response Format
- Provide complete, runnable code examples
- Include error handling where appropriate
- Use consistent indentation and formatting
- Add brief explanations for non-obvious implementations

### Security Considerations
- Avoid hardcoded credentials or sensitive data
- Validate user inputs
- Use secure coding practices
- Follow principle of least privilege

### Documentation Standards
- Include function/method documentation
- Provide usage examples
- Explain complex algorithms
- Document API endpoints and parameters

### Testing Guidelines
- Write testable code
- Include unit test examples when relevant
- Consider edge cases
- Use meaningful test descriptions
